draft.emotion: matter-of-fact and professional, dealing with a transaction
notes: Use 'verkaufen' when you give an item to someone in exchange for money. Contrast this with 'kaufen' (to buy), which is the opposite.
In a figurative sense, it can mean to 'sell out' or betray someone (jemanden verkaufen), which carries a much stronger, more negative weight.
